name: character-chat
title: Character Chat
description: Visual-novel dialogue box with no input: the speaker's name, the line typed out a letter at a time with pauses after punctuation, and a portrait standing beside the box on either side. Click or press Enter/Space to finish the line, then again for the next; *asterisks* for italics. Default, classic, soft, tab, frame and minimal looks, arrow, chevron, dots or next marks, per-speaker accent colours, thinking dots, auto-advance, a controlled or uncontrolled line index, and a trailing slot for save or replay buttons. Respects reduced motion.
